---
description: "Use when making code changes, implementing features, or reviewing pull requests. Enforces scoped changes — each change should be bounded and minimal."
applyTo: '**'
---

# Scoped Changes

- Each change should address ONE concern — don't mix feature work with refactoring
- Only modify files within the scope of the current task
- If you discover a necessary refactor, note it as a separate task instead of doing it in-place
- Keep diffs minimal — reviewers and validators can only assess what they can understand
